definitions.explanation: The day that was two days ago. Part of the sequence: おととい (day before yesterday) → きのう (yesterday) → きょう (today).

examples.japanese: おととい{東京|とうきょう}に{行|い}きました。
examples.english: I went to Tokyo the day before yesterday.

examples.japanese: おとといの{夜|よる}、{雨|あめ}が{降|ふ}りました。
examples.english: It rained the night before last.

examples.japanese: おとといから{風邪|かぜ}です。
examples.english: I've had a cold since the day before yesterday.

notes: Usually written in hiragana. Can also be written as {一昨日|おととい} in kanji. Sometimes pronounced as 'ototsui' in casual speech. Like other time words, it can be used without a particle when indicating when something happened.
